name: Baile Charme AI
tagline: Baile Charme AI turns one photo into a video of you dancing Brazilian charme at a Rio night street party
description: Baile Charme AI is a browser-based generator for the baile charme trend on TikTok, the AI clip of a white-haired grandpa captioned "ninguem botou fe no vovo" who out-dances the whole floor. Upload one clear photo of one person and the AI places them, in their own clothes, on an AI-made Rio night street party and has them dance charme, the slow synchronized Rio dance to R&B and soul. Choose a 10- or 15-second cut. You get a vertical 9:16 720p MP4 with AI sound and no watermark in about 3 to 5 minutes, ready for TikTok, Reels or Shorts. No app and no CapCut template needed. Failed renders return the credits automatically and photos are deleted within 24 hours. People and scenes are AI-generated, not real footage. Available in English, Portuguese and Spanish.
